name: frc
description: Temporal dither (FRC). Every pixel blinks its gray as a duty on a sixteen-frame cycle, so a fast display shows up to sixteen shades on one bit. coarse quantizes to every 2nd or 4th rung for smoother pulse trains, calm turns duties below calm/16 into a spatial mix of black and calm/16 so no pixel blinks below fusion. Shades cost frame rate: sixteen need about 200 fps, which an SSD1306 on I2C reaches only with the bus at 1 MHz, and coarse and calm buy stillness at less.
